snippet.title: Swords of Legends -  Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
"The living are wayfarers yet the dead are homecomers.
In this world we pass through, we mourn the end that comes to all."

Dead yet reborn, you become a Underworld Enforcer, embarking on an adventure to guide the departed.

From Aurogon Shanghai, Swords of Legends is an action RPG built in Unreal Engine 5 that draws on myths and classic tales. It offers a fresh take that sets it apart from traditional Soulslike games, coming soon to PC and Consoles.

Mix of gameplay and cinematics footage, captured in Unreal Engine 5.Work in progress – not representative of final quality.
